name: Somchai Prasertkul
bio:
Somchai Prasertkul's career began in Bangkok's bustling financial district, where he honed his accounting skills at a multinational corporation. However, his true passion lay in motorsport, fueled by childhood memories of watching Formula One races with his father. He transitioned into motorsport finance a decade ago, initially managing budgets for a local racing team before joining the Kart Academy. 

Somchai believes in meticulous financial planning and rigorous cost control. His approach emphasizes transparency and accountability, ensuring that every baht is wisely invested. He is known for his ability to identify and mitigate financial risks, allowing the team to focus on performance without the worry of budget overruns. His calm demeanor, even under pressure, is highly valued by the team.

What sets Somchai apart is his innovative approach to motorsport finance. He is always looking for new ways to optimize spending, leveraging data analysis to identify areas for improvement. He also takes an interest in driver development, understanding that the talent pipeline is a crucial long-term investment.

physical.description: A man of average height with a slightly weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using a fountain pen for all official documents.
Starts every morning with a cup of strong Thai coffee and a detailed review of the previous day's expenditures.
